verdict.rationale: Twenty's docs show workflows triggered by record changes, schedules, manual actions, or webhooks. Workflows can chain record operations, Send email, HTTP requests, code, and branches, and the docs give Slack alerts as an example, so record updates and notifications are covered. Creating tasks is only implied through generic record operations, and no hands-on report confirms these automations work in practice. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a create-task action within workflows, detail on in-app notification actions, independent or hands-on corroboration of workflow reliability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build trigger-based workflows that update records, create tasks, and send notifications automatically

citations.quote: Trigger workflows on record changes, schedules, manual actions, or incoming webhooks.
Workflows can chain any combination of: Record operations... Send email... HTTP request... Code... Branches... Iterator... AI Agent... Delay... Form
Send Slack alerts when a deal reaches a certain stage
Workflows let you automate repetitive tasks and connect Twenty to external tools — without writing code (though you can if you want to).
